description: Untouched GPT-5.4 Mini model-selection holdout created after its perfect development run. Run once and never tune against it.

cases.description: Use two independent constraints and reject unrelated career background.
cases.message: Compare the offer with my need for remote work and my commitment to collect my daughter from school.

candidates.content: The user strongly prefers a remote-first job.
The user is responsible for collecting their daughter from school on weekdays.
The user was promoted in their previous company.

cases.description: A general conceptual explanation has no need for adjacent personal facts.
cases.message: What is the difference between empathy and sympathy?

candidates.content: The user tries to listen carefully when friends are upset.
The user enjoys reading psychology books.

cases.description: Match a Spanish paraphrase to a scoped recurring pattern.
cases.message: ¿Por qué dejo de hablar cuando una conversación se vuelve tensa?

candidates.content: The user becomes quiet during tense conversations because they fear making conflict worse.
The user becomes quiet before giving presentations.

cases.description: Use the relevant event for the named person, not a general relationship label.
cases.message: What agreement did Priya and I make about sharing rent?

candidates.content: The user and Priya agreed to divide the rent equally.
Priya is the user's roommate.

cases.description: An invalidated exact preference and an unrelated active preference both stay out.
cases.message: Did I still want to avoid air travel?

candidates.content: The user prefers to avoid flying.
The user enjoys overnight train travel.

cases.message: Got it, that clears things up.

candidates.content: The user appreciates detailed explanations.

cases.description: Select the exact creative project and reject another project of the same type.
cases.message: Help me get unstuck on the documentary I wanted to edit.

candidates.content: The user wants to edit a short documentary about their neighborhood.
The user wants to produce a podcast about local history.

cases.description: Use the communication preference for the relevant work situation only.
cases.message: How should I ask my new manager to give me instructions?

candidates.content: The user prefers complex work instructions in writing.
The user prefers calling close friends rather than texting them.

cases.description: Choose only the requested value when the limit is one.
cases.message: What mattered most to me about choosing a neighborhood?

candidates.content: The user values a strong sense of community where they live.
The user likes walking in city parks.

cases.description: Use a stored goal that explains a present conflict without selecting topical noise.
cases.message: Why am I tempted to take overtime when I wanted more time for music?

candidates.content: The user wants to reserve more weekly time for making music.
The user enjoys attending live concerts.
